rationale: Sid and Haowen both work at the intersection of computer vision and hardware systems in the San Francisco area, with Sid leading product for Verkada's cloud-based physical security platform and Haowen building robot manipulation systems at Mach9. While their domains differ—physical security vs. robotics—Sid's PM expertise in vision-based products could offer valuable product strategy perspective, and Haowen's robotics and systems background (Python, C++, CUDA) represents technical depth that complements Sid's product leadership.
intro_message: Sid Dedhia, meet Haowen Shi — you're both working with computer vision and hardware in SF, and might find value in comparing approaches to product development at different scales.
